scope: B2 session moderation on disposable WordPress/MariaDB; seeded local SSO links, injected suspension precondition not Hub proof, no economic opening
checks: Normal activation creates no session review schema
Ordinary members cannot install review schema
Explicit review schema installation is idempotent
Profile approval does not approve session rules
Foreign creator cannot submit another session
Submitted session content remains pending
Creator cannot approve their own rules
Foreign creator cannot read private review or history
Concurrent moderation commits one decision only
Session appeal is not an approval
Edited rules cannot reuse a previous approval
Private versioned history preserves exact prior editorial rules
A moderator cannot approve content edited since submission
Approved current rules freeze while opening still awaits Hub proof
Another creator cannot appeal a candidate refusal
Participant recourse is pending and not an admission
Duplicate recourse for the same decision is refused
Session organizer cannot read another participant private recourse
Owner queue has no recipient override
Only the moderator can decide a participant appeal
Concurrent recourse decisions commit one case revision
Favourable moderator recourse admits only future contributions
Prior appeal remains available without rewriting its decision
Moderation revocation stops choices and awaits effective close proof
Closing is not sufficient for readmission
Participant recourse cannot reopen a closed context
Closed recourse can be reasoned without inventing an admission
Review and exact snapshot roll back when journal fails
Case, admission and session journal roll back together on appeal audit failure
Retry after rolled back audit commits one future admission
Injected effective suspension allows versioned metadata readmission only
Cancellation cannot be transformed into readmission
Every review revision has one exact private historical snapshot
Every appeal revision has one durable decision event
Editorial guard refuses use outside an existing transaction
Concurrent editorial withdrawal waits for the admission transaction
Editorial guard preserves the caller transaction until release
Withdrawal commits after release and prevents subsequent admission
Divergent review storage fails closed
No score or economic operation is exposed by moderation
